Leef Browser uses direct public RSS feed: Leef Browser uses direct public RSS feeds (such as BBC, Yahoo, or custom feeds). Unlike other browsers that track what you read, Leef fetches news directly from servers to your machine with no middleman.
When you like, dislike, or dismiss conte: When you like, dislike, or dismiss content, topic weights are stored and computed exclusively inside your local browser. Preferences NEVER leave your device and are never sent to news providers or Leef.
When you dismiss or tune a headline, tha: When you dismiss or tune a headline, that preference is stored exclusively in your local browser settings. We do not send this feedback to news providers or any server.
Live scores are fetched directly from ES: Live scores are fetched directly from ESPN's public APIs. Because you are fetching RSS feeds and s: Because you are fetching RSS feeds and scores directly, providers may see your IP address and basic browser info. If you click on an article, you are leaving Leef's local environment, where their standard privacy policies apply.
